order_templates.intent: Halt the detachment and rest the men. Keep watch; defend yourselves if attacked.
order_templates.label: Rest and recover

order_templates.effect: Withdraw toward the selected hex. Avoid closing with observed threats; defend if the way is blocked.
order_templates.intent: Fall back to the appointed position, preserving the detachment; report when established.
order_templates.label: Retreat to position

order_templates.effect: Use the nearest friendly ammunition point. Load from finite stocks only while adjacent and clear of contact.
order_templates.intent: Proceed to our ammunition point and replenish your cartridge boxes. Report shortages.
order_templates.label: Replenish ammunition

order_templates.effect: Move cautiously to the selected hex, then maintain observation. Does not confer scout skill or reveal hidden troops.
order_templates.intent: Examine the appointed ground, observe the enemy and send word. Avoid a close engagement.
order_templates.label: Reconnoiter position

order_templates.effect: Work takes time and increases fatigue. Tools and ground determine progress; fire interrupts construction. Cover remains on this hex when the unit leaves.
order_templates.intent: Strengthen your present position with hasty fieldworks. Keep watch and report when ready.
order_templates.label: Dig in

order_templates.effect: The detachment does not open fire; it returns fire once enemy fire strikes it. Its mission is unchanged.
order_templates.intent: Do not fire unless fired upon. Keep your present instructions.
order_templates.label: Hold fire

order_templates.effect: The detachment fires on the nearest enemy in range. Its mission is unchanged.
order_templates.intent: Engage the enemy within range. Keep your present instructions.
order_templates.label: Open fire
